messages.content:
Risk: False or misleading information (ID: mit-ai-risk-subdomain-3.1)
Description: AI systems that inadvertently generate or spread incorrect or deceptive information, which can lead to inaccurate beliefs in users and undermine their autonomy. Humans that make decisions based on false beliefs can experience physical, emotional or material harms
Concern: None
Policy: Clinical Diagnosis & Treatment Recommendations

Axis: automated system (https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/AgentsAndPeople/Agents/AutomatedSystem)
Roles: agent
Subclasses:
  - https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/RealEstateLoans/MortgageOrigination/AutomatedUnderwritingSystem: automated underwriting system

Axis: Health Misinformation (http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HealthMisinformation)
Roles: object
Siblings:
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PoliticalMisinformation: Political Misinformation
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ScientificMisinformation: Scientific Misinformation
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ElectionMisinformation: Election Misinformation

Axis: Disinformation (http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Disinformation)
Roles: object
Subclasses:
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeepfakeDisinformation: Deepfake Disinformation
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#StateSponsoredPropaganda: State-Sponsored Propaganda
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ConspiracyTheoryPromotion: Conspiracy Theory Promotion
